points.point: Does changing the email lose credits?
points.sentence: Change the email on your existing account instead of creating a new one. This keeps your credits, videos, posts, and settings.

points.point: Does changing the email lose videos?
points.sentence: Change the email on your existing account instead of creating a new one. This keeps your credits, videos, posts, and settings.

points.point: Is making a new account better?
points.sentence: Credits and content are tied to your account and do not transfer between separate accounts.

verdict.reason: The entry states that changing the email on the existing account keeps credits and videos, and that a new account would start without them, which answers all three of the customer's questions.
